body: اللاعب باق في السعودية حسم الأوروجواياني داروين نونيز، مهاجم الهلال السعودي، وجهته المقبلة، بعدما توصل نادي الدرعية إلى اتفاق لضمه خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الحالية، ليبتعد اللاعب بذلك عن الانتقال إلى طرابزون سبور التركي. وكان نونيز قد ارتبط خلال الأيام الماضية بالانتقال إلى طرابزون سبور، في صفقة كان من شأنها أن تجمعه مجددًا بزميله السابق في ليفربول، محمد صلاح، بعدما لعب الثنائي معًا لعدة سنوات بقميص الريدز. تذاكر مباريات طرابزون سبور في الدوري التركي!اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ! لكن الصحفي الإيطالي الموثوق فابريزيو رومانو حسم الجدل، مؤكدًا عبر حسابه على منصة "إكس" وجود اتفاق شفهي بين الهلال والدرعية بشأن انتقال نونيز إلى الفريق السعودي. وأوضح رومانو أن نونيز سينضم إلى الدرعية على سبيل الإعارة حتى يونيو 2027، مع تحمل راتبه خلال فترة الإعارة، بينما لا يتضمن الاتفاق الحالي بندًا يتيح شراء اللاعب بشكل نهائي. وأشار الصحفي الإيطالي إلى أن الصفقة لا تزال بحاجة إلى توقيع العقود، لكن الاتفاق تم بالفعل بين الأطراف، كما يجري حاليًا الترتيب لخضوع اللاعب للفحص الطبي تمهيدًا لإتمام انتقاله رسميًا. 🚨🇸🇦 Darwin Núñez to Al Diriyah, here we go! title: This leaked Motorola accessory could change how you charge your phone
summary: The leaked charger sports a slim design, braided cable, and USB-C connector.
body: TL;DR Leaked images show a purported Motorola magnetic wireless charging puck called Moto Snap. The charger resembles Apple’s MagSafe puck, with a USB-C connection and braided cable. The “Snap” moniker implies an effortless, grab-and-go charger that eliminates the alignment fuss of traditional pads. Motorola continues expanding its hardware ecosystem with modern, premium accessories. Following recent leaks regarding a potential Moto Watch Ultra , newly surfaced information suggests the company is also developing a dedicated magnetic wireless charger. Dubbed the Moto Snap, this unverified accessory looks poised to rival Apple’s MagSafe and serve as the perfect companion for the Motorola Edge 70 Max . Apple popularized magnetic wireless charging years ago, setting an industry benchmark for convenience. Google recently embraced the standard, completely integrating it into its flagship hardware. However, legacy Android brands have noticeably lagged in adopting native magnetic charging. This latest leak from the Evleaks account on X indicates Motorola is bridging that critical feature gap.

title: Wearables are splitting into two camps, and Garmin is winning one
summary: Choosing between feature-packed sports watches and screenless trackers.
body: TL;DR Wearable shipments fell 2% year over year in Q2 2026, and consumers are increasingly choosing between premium sports watches and screenless trackers. Garmin gained major smartwatch market share, while Samsung and Apple both lost ground year over year. Screenless trackers are gaining momentum as consumers look for wearables that track their health without constant notifications and distractions. Over the past several years, the wearable market has grown to be diverse and full of different options, and that might just be making consumers a lot more selective. Research firm Omdia has just published preliminary sales figures for the second quarter of 2026, and in addition to highlighting a decline in year-over-year shipments, it also spotlights a growing divide. Overall wrist-based wearable shipments fell by 2% compared to the second quarter of 2025, but that decline doesn’t paint the full picture. The consumer market also seems to be split between two very different types of wearable bands: screenless trackers and the more sophisticated “feature-rich sports watches” from the likes of Garmin.
